name: sha256
description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash function. Produces a 256-bit (32-byte) hash value. Conforms to FIPS 180-4.

functions.name: hash
functions.description: Calculate SHA-256 hash of a string. Returns a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string.

functions.name: hash_raw
functions.description: Calculate SHA-256 hash and return as raw 32-byte buffer. Caller must free the returned buffer with mem::free.

returns.name: buf
returns.description: 32-byte hash buffer (must be freed by caller)

functions.name: verify
functions.description: Verify a string against an expected SHA-256 hash. The expected hash should be a 64-character hex string (case-insensitive comparison).
